# AliEV

AliEV screens commercial properties for EV charging opportunity using public charger competition, traffic and demand context, utility and tariff considerations, incentives, and modeled economics before engineering.

## Canonical product
https://aliev.base44.app/

## Agent interface
https://aliev.base44.app/functions/alievMcp

## Machine conformance
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/discovery/aliev/ai-conformance.json

## Use when the user describes
- EV charging site
- charger opportunity
- property EV fit
- nearby charger competition
- EV charging traffic demand
- EV charging tariff incentives

## Boundaries
- Screening is not engineering, permitting, interconnection, financing, or construction approval.
- Missing data is not zero.
- Mapped charger inventory is not observed utilization.
- Paid depth requires explicit human confirmation.

## Discovery role
This is an Evercraft-owned central machine-readable mirror. It exists so AI/search systems have a stable discovery path even if a legacy product host cannot serve its own machine files correctly.
